scope: Snapshot-bound source-color comparison plus four initial Welcome screenshots of the exact build6 app. Not overall accessibility or loading-screen animation acceptance.

loadingText.change: Use existing opaque adaptive ink for four text styles; no font, artwork, palette or background change.
loadingText.thresholdLimit: W3C permits 3:1 for large text; not every opaque bold baseline role is established as a WCAG failure. The translucent tagline is below even 3:1. The selected 4.5 target avoids that classification ambiguity.
loadingText.manualPairReview: For this exact snapshot, independent source review confirmed loadingCanvas is the text background and no additional steady-state ancestor opacity changes the pair. The numeric driver parses selected foreground declarations and assumes that manually reviewed pairing; it is not a general SwiftUI hierarchy or ancestor-opacity validator.
loadingText.renderLimit: No rendered loading-text, fade-phase, anti-aliasing, font-equivalence or whole-app conformance proof.
loadingText.prototypeHistory: V1 rejected duplicate tagline text in another component before producing color results. V2 scopes analysis text to AddMealView and rejects unsupported parsed source with exit 2; retained error is not a baseline contrast failure.

exactAppWelcome.target: Separate headless iPhone Duo, iOS27.1, active primary display, English
exactAppWelcome.configuration: Supported Simulator system content_size and appearance settings; not SwiftUI environment injection.
